query: How do you get in trouble for putting the same house on the books twice?
reference_answer:
Dual Registration of Same Property:
The penalty can include imprisonment up to 7 years and/or a fine, under Section 467 of the IPC for forgery of valuable security, and also attract penalties under the Registration Act, 1908.
answer: You can get in trouble for putting the same house on the books twice by committing mortgage fraud, which is a serious crime. [System]
